title: Dyson's cross-country drive with Feynman

tellings.quote: driving from Cleveland to Albuquerque and he offered to take me for a ride just to see the country

plain: Sometime in the late 1940s, the young physicist Freeman Dyson rode across America with the physicist Richard Feynman, who was driving from Cleveland to Albuquerque and "offered to take me for a ride just to see the country." Dyson tells this himself, in his own words heard on an episode of the show, as a memory of the trip he took with Feynman.
